name: Lemonsoft Oyj
summary: Lemonsoft Oyj, founded in Vaasa, Finland, in 2006, specializes in the design, development, and sale of enterprise resource planning (ERP) software solutions, serving clients both domestically and internationally. Their comprehensive product suite offers modules to automate and streamline various business functions: Financial Management: This transforms manual tasks like accounting, invoicing, purchase invoice processing, order management, payroll (including official notifications), tax filing, and financial statement preparation into efficient, electronic workflows. Payroll and Personnel Administration: Features cover personal registers, competence tracking, event management, payroll processing, wage payments, reporting, travel and expense claims, detailed time recording (including physical time stamping), shift planning, production work and project supervision, and holiday/leave management. Customer Relationship Management (CRM): Provides crucial tools for deep customer insight, optimizing sales strategies, and facilitating overall business management. Business Intelligence (BI): Supports informed decision-making by enabling effective data management, automating reporting, assisting with strategy implementation and communication, and delivering standard analytical solutions. LemonFiles: A dedicated cloud-based platform for robust data management. Project Management: Oversees projects from the initial tender phase through implementation, seamlessly integrating with accounting. Reporting and Management Tools: Includes dynamic reporting features and additional managerial utilities. Resource Management: Offers clear visibility into available organizational resources. Logistics: Boasts extensive capabilities for managing a company's material flows and entire supply chain. Production Control: Facilitates the planning and oversight of diverse production methods. Additionally, Lemonsoft provides essential service interfaces, such as LemonHUB, which streamlines the electronic exchange of invoices, orders, and confirmations, alongside other proprietary software products. The company caters to a wide range of industries, including industrial manufacturing, wholesale and retail, professional services automation, construction and contracting, and accounting firms.
